an6.53:1.1: [sāvatthinidānaṃ] atha kho aññataro brāhmaṇo yena bhagavā tenupasaṅkami. upasaṅkamitvā bhagavatā saddhiṃ sammodi.
an6.53:1.2: sammodanīyaṃ kathaṃ sārāṇīyaṃ vītisāretvā ekamantaṃ nisīdi. ekamantaṃ nisinno kho so brāhmaṇo bhagavantaṃ etadavoca:
an6.53:2.1: atthi nu kho bho gotama eko dhammo bhāvito bahulīkato yo ubho atthe samadhigayha tiṭṭhati diṭṭhadhammikañceva atthaṃ, yo ca attho samparāyikoti.
an6.53:2.2: atthi kho brāhmaṇa, eko dhammo bhāvito bahulīkato yo ubho atthe samadhigayha tiṭṭhati diṭṭhadhammikañceva atthaṃ, yo ca attho samparāyikoti.
an6.53:3.1: katamo pana bho gotama eko dhammo bhāvito bahulīkato yo ubho atthe samadhigayha tiṭṭhati diṭṭhadhammikañceva atthaṃ, yo ca attho samparāyikoti.
an6.53:3.2: appamādo kho brāhmaṇa, eko dhammo bhāvito bahulīkato ubho atthe samadhigayha tiṭṭhati diṭṭhadhammikañceva atthaṃ, yo ca attho samparāyiko. (1)
an6.53:4.1: seyyathāpi brāhmaṇa, yāni kānici jaṅgamānaṃ pāṇānaṃ padajātāni, sabbāni tāni hatthipade samodhānaṃ gacchanti. hatthipadaṃ tesaṃ aggamakkhāyati yadidaṃ mahattena.
an6.53:4.2: evameva kho brāhmaṇa appamādo eko dhammo bhāvito bahulīkato ubho atthe samadhigayha tiṭṭhati diṭṭhadhammikañceva atthaṃ, yo ca attho samparāyiko. (2)
an6.53:5.1: seyyathāpi brāhmaṇa, kūṭāgārassa yā kāci gopānasiyo sabbā tā kūṭaṅgamā kūṭaninnā kūṭasamosaraṇā, kūṭaṃ tāsaṃ aggamakkhāyati.
an6.53:6.1: seyyathāpi brāhmaṇa, babbajalāyako babbajaṃ lāyitvā agge gahetvā odhunāti, niddhunāti, nicchādeti.
an6.53:7.1: seyyathāpi brāhmaṇa, ambapiṇḍiyā vaṇṭacchinnāya yāni kānici ambāni vaṇṭupanibandhanāni, sabbāni tāni tadanvayāni bhavanti.
an6.53:8.1: seyyathāpi brāhmaṇa, ye keci kuḍḍarājāno sabbe te rañño cakkavattissa anuyuttā bhavanti, rājā tesaṃ cakkavatti aggamakkhāyati.
an6.53:9.1: seyyathāpi brāhmaṇa, yā kāci tārakarūpānaṃ pabhā, sabbā tā candappabhāya kalaṃ nāgghanti soḷasiṃ, candappabhā tāsaṃ aggamakkhāyati.
an6.53:9.2: evameva kho brāhmaṇa, appamādo eko dhammo bhāvito bahulīkato ubho atthe samadhigayha diṭṭhadhammikañceva atthaṃ, yo cattho samparāyiko.
an6.53:10.1: ayaṃ kho brāhmaṇa, eko dhammo bhāvito bahulīkato ubho atthe samadhigayha tiṭṭhati diṭṭhadhammikañceva atthaṃ, yo cattho samparāyikoti.
an6.53:11.2: upāsakaṃ maṃ bhavaṃ gotamo dhāretu ajjatagge pāṇupetaṃ saraṇaṃ gatanti.
